text: Ill tak two kilos of the peachs plaese
meaning: The customer wants to buy two kilograms of peaches.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to the Waterfront?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ja, dit sal so twintig minute wees.

text: Ek se vir jou, die brug is toe, ons moet oor Kloofstraat ry.
meaning: The driver says the bridge is closed, so they must go via Kloof Street.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Die bobotie het geroosterde amandels bo-op.

text: Can you leave them off? My son is allergic.
meaning: The customer asks for the almonds to be left off the bobotie because their son is allergic.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The doctor gave me this prescription for antibiotics.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Reg so, ek maak dit vir jou klaar.

text: Neem een kapsule na ontbyt en een voor jy gaan le.
meaning: The pharmacist says to take one capsule after breakfast and one before going to bed.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ja, meneer Botha, is alles reg met die kamer?

text: Can you send two extra pillars up to my room? The bed only has one
meaning: The guest in room 308 wants two extra pillows because the bed only has one.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Excuse me, where's the nearest post office?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Die poskantoor? Gaan reguit met hierdie straat af.

text: Draai links by die robot, dan is dit net 'n entjie verder, jy kan dit nie mis nie, bru.
meaning: Turn left at the traffic light and the post office is a short way further, friend.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Plesier! My pa het die vleis self gebraai.

text: Your dad's braai was lowkey fire ngl, that boerewors slapped
meaning: The speaker says honestly the dad's braai was excellent and the boerewors was delicious.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Do you have avocados and mangoes?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ja, die avokado's is R12 elk en die mango's R9.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The mangoes look a bit soft.

text: Hulle het eers gister ingekom, ek gee vir jou vier vir R28.
meaning: The vendor says the mangoes only arrived yesterday and offers four for R28.

text: Pleas drop me at the secnd gate, not the main entrence
meaning: The passenger wants to be dropped at the second gate of the hospital, not the main entrance.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Klink lekker, maar ek moet eers iets vra.

text: Ek is allergis vir skulpvis, is daar garnaal in die paela?
meaning: The diner is allergic to shellfish and asks whether the paella contains shrimp.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Hierdie stroop is vir die hoes en die tablette vir die koors.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Tien milliliter twee keer per dag.

text: Is it safe for my daughter? She's only six.
meaning: The customer asks whether the cough syrup is safe for their six-year-old daughter.

history.speaker: B
history.text: In die eetkamer op die grondvloer.

text: Ontbyt is gewoonlik van sewe tot tien, maar more begin dit eers om agt want dis 'n vakansiedag.
meaning: Breakfast is usually 7 to 10, but tomorrow it starts at 8 because it is a public holiday.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I get to the library?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ry tot by die verkeerssirkel en draai regs.

text: So right at the circle and the library is on the lift side?
meaning: The speaker confirms turning right at the roundabout and asks if the library is on the left side.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Did you watch the rugby yesterday?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Natuurlik! Ek het by my broer gekyk.

text: Jinne, die Bokke het lekker gespeel, nè? Ek was skoon in my noppies.
meaning: The speaker says the Springboks played really well and they were absolutely delighted.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How much for this woven basket?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Daardie een is R50, ek het dit self gemaak.

text: Fifty bucks is kinda steep tho, can you do 40?
meaning: The buyer thinks R50 is a bit expensive and offers R40 for the basket.

history.speaker: A
history.text: We're here, thanks. How much is it?

text: Die meter wys R85 maar gee my maar R80, die verkeerd was erg.
meaning: The meter shows R85 but the driver accepts R80 because the traffic was bad.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Die hoender-kerrie is vandag se spesiale gereg.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Dit kom met rys en sambals.

text: Does the curry have any cream or milk? I'm lactose intolerable
meaning: The diner asks whether the chicken curry contains cream or milk because they are lactose intolerant.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Where can I buy a SIM card?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Daar is 'n Vodacom-winkel en 'n PEP langs mekaar in die sentrum.

text: Die tweede een bly tot nege oop, die eerste een maak al om vyf toe.
meaning: PEP stays open until nine, while the Vodacom shop closes at five.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Uitteken is om elfuur, mevrou Naidoo.

text: Can I chek out at 1 instaed of 11? My flihgt is only tonight
meaning: The guest asks to check out at 1 pm instead of 11 am because her flight is tonight.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Welcome to the Protea Lodge, how was your trip?

text: Ek kry geen ontvangs nie, wat is die wifi-wagwoord? Ek moet dringent my vrou bel.
meaning: The guest has no phone signal and asks for the Wi-Fi password because he urgently needs to call his wife.

text: ok gimme 3 kilos of tomatos and 1 of onoins
meaning: The buyer wants 3 kilos of tomatoes and 1 kilo of onions.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you make this dish without nuts?

history.speaker: B
history.text: አዎ፣ ምን አይነት ለውዝ ነው የማይስማማዎት?

meaning: The chef says the sauce contains peanuts, but it can be made without them for Selam.

history.text: I need something for a headache.

history.text: And this cough syrup for my son?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ሽሮፑ ለልጆች ነው፣ በቀን ሶስት ጊዜ።

text: How many ml of it should he take each time?
meaning: The customer asks how many milliliters of the cough syrup the son should take per dose.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to Bole airport?

text: ኮንትራት ነው 620 ብር፣ ፈታ በል ሰአቱ ይደርሳል
meaning: The driver says a private hire costs 620 birr and tells the passenger to relax, they will arrive on time.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Do you have anything for back pain?

history.speaker: B
history.text: አይቡፕሮፌን አለ። ምግብ ከበሉ በኋላ ይውሰዱት።

text: Can I take 2 Anvil at once or just one?
meaning: The customer asks whether to take two ibuprofen (Advil) tablets at once or only one.

text: እሱን አልፈው ወደ ግራ ይታጠፉ፣ 7 ደቂቃ አይፈጅም
meaning: Walk past the university gate and turn left; the museum is less than 7 minutes away.

history.text: Hi, I booked a room under Dawit.

history.speaker: B
history.text: እንኳን ደህና መጡ። ለስንት ሌሊት ነው?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ክፍል 214 ነው፣ ቁርስ ከ1 ሰአት ጀምሮ።

text: Sweet, any chance I can bail at noon on checkout day?
meaning: Dawit asks if he can check out late, at noon, on his departure day.

meaning: The vendor offers two large jars of honey for 950 birr together.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Does the injera have wheat in it?

text: yes pls only teff, even a littel wheat makes me realy sick
meaning: The diner wants pure teff injera because even a small amount of wheat makes them very ill.

text: ወንድሜ ዮናስ እዛ ሆተል አለው፣ 12 ክፍል ብቻ
meaning: The speaker's brother Yonas owns a small hotel in Bahir Dar with only 12 rooms.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I want to buy a scarf and a basket.

history.speaker: B
history.text: ይህ ነጠላ 180 ብር፣ ሞሰቡ 730 ብር ነው።

text: Would you take 600 for it if I pay cash?
meaning: The buyer offers 600 birr cash for the basket (mesob).

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is this minibus going to Merkato?

text: ወያላው ሲጠራ ውረድ፣ አውቶቡስ ተራ ላይ ነው
meaning: Get off when the conductor calls out the stop; it is at Autobus Tera.

text: Great, also no sesame oil pls, my wife Hana is allergic to sesame seeds and rolls
meaning: The diner asks for no sesame oil because his wife Hana is allergic to sesame (autocorrect turned it into 'seeds and rolls').

text: ለሷ 5 ሚሊ በየ6 ሰአቱ፣ ከ4 ጊዜ በላይ አይሆንም
meaning: Give the six-year-old daughter 5 ml every 6 hours, no more than 4 times a day.

text: No cap, this slaps. Lemme grab half a kilo
meaning: The customer says the coffee is truly excellent and wants to buy half a kilo.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I get to the Sheraton?

text: ሁለተኛው መብራት ላይ ወደ ቀኘ ታጠፉ፣ 300 ሜትር ያህል
meaning: Turn right at the second traffic light; the hotel is about 300 meters further.

text: thats to much, my freind paid 220 yesterdey
meaning: The passenger says 350 birr is too much because his friend paid 220 birr yesterday.

text: አሪፍ ነው ግን ፈተናው ይደፍራል ጀለስ
meaning: The student says engineering is cool but the exams are really tough, buddy.

history.speaker: A
history.text: We have two bags, the red one is heavy.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The blue one has my laptop.

text: Please be careful with it, and leave the other one at the front desk
meaning: Handle the blue bag with the laptop carefully; leave the red bag at the front desk.

text: በቀን 2 ጊዜ ለ10 ቀን፣ ከምግብ በሁዋላ ይውሰዱ
meaning: Take the amoxicillin twice a day for 10 days, after meals.

history.text: How much are the dates per kilo?

text: Ill take two kilso of dates and half a kilo of figs
meaning: Customer wants 2 kg of dates and 0.5 kg of figs.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to the airport?

text: Thats fine, my flight is at 9:40 so no rush hour
meaning: Passenger says it's fine, flight is at 9:40 so there is no hurry (autocorrect added 'hour').

history.speaker: A
history.text: Does the lentil soup have any nuts?

history.speaker: B
history.text: الشوربة لا، بس السلطة فيها جوز.

text: No, please don't serve it to me at all, even without them
meaning: Customer refuses the salad entirely, even with the walnuts removed.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, I have a reservation under Morgan.

history.speaker: B
history.text: أهلاً، غرفة مزدوجة لثلاث ليالي، صح؟

meaning: Guest is pleased, says the air conditioner at the previous hotel was broken, asks staff to confirm this room's AC works.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I need something for a bad cough.

history.text: No, it's for my son, he's six.

history.speaker: B
history.text: خمسة ملي ثلاث مرات في اليوم.

text: So 5 ml tree times a day, and shuold he take it after food?
meaning: Parent confirms 5 ml three times daily for the 6-year-old and asks whether to take it after meals.

history.text: Excuse me, where is the post office?

history.speaker: B
history.text: امشِ دغري لحد الجامع، وبعدين يمين.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The mosque with the green dome?

text: Okay, so I pass that one and turn right at the next one?
meaning: Asker confirms: walk past the green-domed mosque and turn right at the second mosque near the pharmacy.

text: Honestly it's been a blast, the food is fire
meaning: Visitor says the trip has been great so far and the food is excellent.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How much for this copper tray?

text: I can do 300 if you throw in the small tea pit
meaning: Buyer offers 300 dirhams for the copper tray if the seller adds the small teapot for free.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is there shellfish in the rice?

history.speaker: B
history.text: السمك المشوي بدون أي حاجة بحرية تانية.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Around 6. Also my wife left her charger at the pool.

meaning: Guest asks that the wife's charger, if found, be sent to the room before the wife goes to sleep.

history.text: Which bus goes to the old city?

history.speaker: B
history.text: الباص رقم ١٤، بس المحطة بعيدة شوي.

text: تقريبا ربع ساعه مشي، او خد تكسي باقل من عشرين

history.text: How much is the big jar?

meaning: Large jar is 260, small is 120, and they taste the same.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you drive faster? I'm late.

history.speaker: B
history.text: فيه طريق من ورا بس أطول.

text: ولا يهمك، هاخد الدائري وهنوصل في السليم، بس الأجرة هتزيد حبة
meaning: Driver says don't worry, he'll take the ring road and arrive safely on time, but the fare will rise a bit.

history.speaker: A
history.text: My daughter is allergic to sesame.

history.speaker: B
history.text: العيش اللي عليه سمسم خليه، الأبيض كويس.

text: بس الزيت اللي بنقلي فيه نفسه، فخليها تاكل منه بحذر
meaning: The falafel is fried in the same oil as sesame items, so the daughter should eat the falafel cautiously.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can I get a late checkout?

text: ممكن لحد وحدة الظهر مجانا، بعدها نص يوم إضافي بسبعين دولار
meaning: Free until 1 pm; after that a half-day charge of 70 dollars (autocorrect garbled 'واحدة').

history.speaker: A
history.text: No. How do I take it?

text: حبه كل اثنا عشر ساعه لمده سبعه ايام، ولا توقفها حتى لو تحسنت
meaning: One pill every 12 hours for 7 days; don't stop even if feeling better.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I'm looking for the Nour bookshop.

history.speaker: B
history.text: فيه اثنين، واحد بالسوق وواحد قدام الجامعة.

text: بس هو يسكر بدري يوم الجمعة، فروح له قبل الظهر
meaning: The bookshop opposite the university closes early on Friday, so go before noon.

history.speaker: B
history.text: أيوه، عندي محل ورد في الشارع اللي جنبه.

text: الحمد لله ماشية، بس الصيف ده كان واقع خالص
meaning: Business is okay, but this summer it was very slow.

history.text: Is it made in the same kitchen as the bread?

text: نعم نفس المطبح، فما اقدر اضمنلك مية بالميه
meaning: Yes, same kitchen, so they can't guarantee it is 100% gluten-free.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I bought these scarves from your brother yesterday.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The blue one has a hole.

text: خلاص أبدلها لك بالخضراء، وهو بيرجع لك الفرق بكرة
meaning: Seller will swap the blue scarf for the green one, and his brother will refund the price difference tomorrow.

text: ok 110 is fine, gimme two dozn
meaning: The buyer accepts 110 rupees per dozen and wants two dozen oranges.

text: দুশ পঞ্চাশ গ্ৰমৰ দম ১৮০ টক
meaning: The seller says 250 grams of Jorhat tea costs 180 rupees.

text: Gonna be late, step on it pls, train's at 6:40
meaning: The passenger asks the driver to hurry because the train leaves at 6:40.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I left a bag in your taxi yesterday.

text: সেইটো মোৰ ঘৰত আছে, কাইলৈ আনি দিম।
meaning: The driver has the blue laptop bag at his home and will bring it tomorrow.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Does the fish curry have mustard?

history.speaker: B
history.text: হয়, সৰিয়হৰ তেল আৰু বাটা সৰিয়হ দিয়া আছে।

text: I'll get that one then, mustard makes my throat swell
meaning: The customer orders the dal because a mustard allergy makes their throat swell.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is there peanut in the pitha?

text: লাৰুত চিনাবদাম আছে, নাখব দেই
meaning: The vendor warns that the laru contains peanuts, so the customer should not eat it.

text: The AC in my room is making a loud noose, can someone come?
meaning: The guest in room 314 says the AC is making a loud noise and asks for someone to come.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can I check out late tomorrow?

text: একো টেনচন নাই, ২ বজালৈ থাকক, এক্সট্ৰা নালাগে।
meaning: The receptionist says it's no problem: the guest can stay until 2 pm with no extra charge.

text: so 5ml thrice a day, befor or aftr food?
meaning: The parent confirms 5 ml three times a day for the 6-year-old and asks whether to give it before or after food.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I have two tablets from the doctor, a white one and a yellow one.

text: হালধীয়াখন ভাত খোৱাৰ আগত এটা, আনটো জ্বৰ উঠিলেহে খাব।
meaning: The pharmacist says to take one yellow gas tablet before meals and the white fever tablet only when there is a fever.

text: so past the pump or b4 it?
meaning: The tourist asks whether the ATM is after or before the petrol pump.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I get to the State Museum?

text: ৩ নম্বৰ বছ, দিঘলপুখুৰীত নামি বাওঁফল খোজ কাঢ়ক
meaning: The local says to take bus number 3, get off at Dighalipukhuri and walk to the left.

history.speaker: B
history.text: আপুনি কালি বিহু চাবলৈ গৈছিল নে?

text: Bihu was lit last night, the dhol guys were insane
meaning: The visitor loved the Bihu show at Latasil field last night, especially the amazing dhol drummers.

text: এক্কেবাৰে জম্পেছ ঠাই নহয়নে? অগ্নিগড় চাইছিলনে?
meaning: The local says Tezpur is a really great place and asks if the visitor saw Agnigarh.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Show me the mekhela chador sets.

text: Too much for me, I'll take the other one if it's under 4000
meaning: The muga set at 7500 rupees is too expensive, so the buyer will take the pat silk set if it costs under 4000 rupees.

text: ৰৌ মছ কিলত ৩৪০, ডাঙৰবোৰ ৩৬০
meaning: The fishmonger says rohu is 340 rupees per kilo and the big ones are 360.

text: Drop me at Fancy Bazar ghat, my sister is waiting there with the kidneys
meaning: The passenger wants to be dropped at Fancy Bazar ghat, where his sister is waiting with the kids.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can I order to my room?

history.text: My wife feels sick in buses.

meaning: The customer asks for motion sickness pills for his wife's 3-hour bus ride to Shillong tomorrow.

text: Ill take two kilo of the pomegranats and half a kilo of the walnts
meaning: The customer wants to buy 2 kg of pomegranates and 0.5 kg of walnuts.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to the airport?

history.text: Yes. How much will it cost?

meaning: The taxi driver says the fare is 25 manat, but 30 manat after midnight.

history.text: My son is allergic to sesame.

history.text: Bu siropu için, gündə üç dəfə, yeməkdən sonra.

history.text: How often do I use the cream?

meaning: The customer asks whether their eight-year-old daughter can also use the eye drops.

history.text: How do I get to the beach from here?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Pots anar-hi caminant o en bus.

meaning: It is about a 25-minute walk; go straight ahead until you reach the sea.

meaning: The passenger no longer needs the ride to the Marco Polo hotel because a friend will pick her up at Ayala Center.

meaning: The customer is allergic to shellfish and must not have any crab or shrimp, including the shrimp paste in the kangkong.

meaning: The turon has no peanuts, but it is cooked in the same pan as the kalamay, which contains peanuts.

history.text: Room 314, ser. Breakfast alas siete hangtod alas diyes.

meaning: Guest Delgado in room 314 asks for a late checkout on Sunday at around 3 pm.

history.text: The aircon in my room isn't working.

meaning: The receptionist will send the technician Dodong to fix the aircon in room 508 within fifteen minutes.

history.text: Something for my son's fever, he's six.

history.text: Paracetamol syrup ni, 250 mg kada 5 ml.

meaning: The mother asks how many ml of the 250 mg/5 ml paracetamol syrup her six-year-old son should take and how often.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I need amoxicillin, I have a prescription.

text: Imnon ni tulo ka beses kada adlaw, pero ang usa kaduha ra
meaning: The 500 mg amoxicillin capsule is taken three times a day, while the cough syrup is taken only twice a day.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Diretso lang, dayon liko sa wala sa simbahan.

history.text: The big church with the bell tower?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Oo, ang Basilica. Tapad ra niya.

text: Is it open now or only in the morning?
meaning: The tourist asks whether Magellan's Cross is open now or only in the morning.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I get to Carbon Market?

text: naug ka sa ktapusan, tpad sa Gaisano, mga 25 mins ra
meaning: The rider should get off the 04L jeep at the last stop next to Gaisano, about 25 minutes away.

history.text: I'm from Seattle, first time in Cebu.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Nindot! Nakatilaw na ka sa lechon?

meaning: The visitor from Seattle says the lechon was honestly the best thing she has ever eaten.

history.text: What do you do on weekends?

text: Tagay mi sa barkada, videoke hangtod kadlawon, kuyaw kaayo bay
meaning: On weekends the Mandaue local drinks with friends and sings videoke until dawn, which he says is a blast.

history.text: Can you clean it for me?

meaning: The buyer wants half a kilo of cleaned squid at 280 pesos per kilo plus about ten calamansi.

text: Ugh no way, just take whatever route's fastest, I'm hella late
meaning: The passenger tells the driver to take the fastest route to SM Seaside because he is very late.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Gusto ka og dessert? Leche flan o halo-halo?

text: I'm lactose intolerant, can you make mine with no diary and no ice cream?
meaning: The customer is lactose intolerant and asks for the halo-halo without milk or ice cream.

text: magsira alas nuybe sa gbii, pro ang gym 24 oras bkas
meaning: The sixth-floor pool closes at 9 pm, but the gym is open 24 hours.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Do you have something for headache?

text: Usa ka tablet kada unom ka oras, ayaw lapas og upset kada adlaw, human kaon
meaning: Take one 200 mg ibuprofen tablet every six hours after eating, with no more than four (upat) tablets per day.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Medyo, sa Beverly Hills pa. Ang akong ig-agaw si Nonoy naay motor.

text: Oo, pero tagai siya og 120, ayaw pasobra kay maanad na siya
meaning: Yes, cousin Nonoy can take the tourist by motorbike, but she should pay him only 120 pesos and not more, or he will get used to it.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Červená jsou sladší, ty menší hlavně.

text: ok can i get 4 kilo of the red ones, the smaler ones pls
meaning: The customer wants 4 kilograms of the smaller red apples.

meaning: The passenger will pay the taxi fare by card and wants a receipt (autocorrected to 'recipe').

history.text: I'm allergic to nuts, is the sauce safe?

history.text: Okay, I'll skip it. What about the apple strudel?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Štrúdl je s rozinkami a skořicí.

meaning: The customer asks whether the apple strudel also contains nuts, even a small amount.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Heslo je na kartičce u klíče, síť se jmenuje Hotel Vltava.

text: is the wifi kinda janky on the 4th floor or is it just me lol
meaning: The guest asks if the wifi on the fourth floor is unreliable or if the problem is only on their device.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I need something for a sore throat.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Doporučuji tyto pastilky a tento lék proti bolesti.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I take the painkiller?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Dvě tablety dvakrát denně po jídle.

meaning: The customer confirms the dose: two painkiller tablets twice a day after meals.

history.text: Excuse me, where is the Kampa museum?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Jděte dolů k řece a pak přes most.

history.text: And the café Slavia, is that near?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Kavárna je u Národního divadla, hned u nábřeží.

text: wait is it before or after the bridge?
meaning: The tourist asks whether café Slavia is before or after the bridge.

history.speaker: A
history.text: From Canada, I'm traveling around Europe.

history.speaker: B
history.text: A jak se vám líbí Praha?

text: ngl Prague is lowkey my fav city so far
meaning: The speaker honestly says Prague is quietly their favorite city of the trip so far.

text: Do you take cars? I don't have cash
meaning: The customer asks if the honey seller accepts cards (autocorrected to 'cars') because they have no cash.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you book a taxi to the airport for tomorrow?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Hotovo. A snídani chcete zabalit s sebou?

text: actually my flight is earlier, can we move it to 5:45?
meaning: The guest wants the airport taxi moved from 6:30 to 5:45.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Tento sirup s paracetamolem je pro děti.

text: She's 6 and wakes 19 kg
meaning: The daughter is six years old and weighs 19 kilograms (autocorrected to 'wakes').

history.speaker: A
history.text: The yellow ones. Can you do a better price for two kilos?

text: ty zlute hrusky jsou po 45 korunach za kilo, ale dam vam to za 40
meaning: The vendor says the yellow pears are 45 crowns per kilo but will sell them for 40.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to the airport?

history.speaker: A
history.text: Roughly how much will it cost?

text: na letiste to bude tak 650, zalezi na zacpach
meaning: The driver estimates about 650 crowns to the airport, depending on traffic jams.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I can't have dairy, I'm allergic to milk.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Yes, is it okay for me?

text: v tý omáčce je smetana, takže pro vás bacha, radši ne
meaning: The waiter warns that the svíčková sauce contains cream, so the milk-allergic guest should avoid it.

text: snídane je od sedmi do desti v přízemí
meaning: Breakfast is served from 7 to 10 on the ground floor.

history.text: I have a bad headache. What can I take?

history.text: How often can I take it?

text: berte jednu tabletu kazdych osm hodin, max tri denne
meaning: Take one ibuprofen tablet every eight hours, at most three per day.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Sorry, how do I get to the Old Town Square?

history.text: Is it far? Should I take a tram?

text: ne, to je hnedka za rohem, dojdete tam za pět minut v pohodě
meaning: No tram needed; Old Town Square is just around the corner, an easy five-minute walk.

history.text: We're thinking of a day trip to Český Krumlov.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Or maybe Kutná Hora, it's closer.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Kutná Hora je taky fajn, ale je tam hodně lidí.

text: Já byla v tom prvním loni, je to tam fakt krásný
meaning: The speaker visited Český Krumlov last year and says it is really beautiful.

history.text: My son has a cough and my wife has a cold.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Pro manželku doporučuji tyto kapky do nosu.

history.speaker: A
history.text: And this cough syrup is for my son?

text: Ten sirup mu dávejte jen večer, jednu lžičku
meaning: Give the son one teaspoon of the cough syrup, only in the evening.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I booked a ride to the zoo, are you my driver?

history.speaker: A
history.text: How will I recognize your car?

text: Počkám na vás před vchodem, mám bílou škodu
meaning: The driver will wait at the entrance in a white Škoda car (autocorrected to 'škodu', meaning damage).

history.speaker: A
history.text: Yes! I went to the Sparta game last night.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Já jsem to sledoval v televizi.

text: Ten zápas včera byl fakt hustej, ne? Ta třetí třetina byla šílená
meaning: The speaker says last night's hockey game was really awesome and the third period was crazy.

text: Ill take two boxs of the strawbrries please
meaning: Speaker A wants to buy two boxes of strawberries at 35 kroner each.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to Nyhavn?

history.text: My friend Jonas is waiting at Central Station.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Skal vi hente ham på vejen?

meaning: Speaker A asks the driver to pick up Jonas at Central Station first, then drop both of them at Nyhavn.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Does the soup have nuts in it?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Nej, men der er fløde i.

meaning: Speaker A accepts the chicken salad but asks for no cheese because dairy makes them very sick.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Måske, hvor sent har I brug for?

text: Can we keep the room until 2? Our fight is at 7 tonight
meaning: Speaker A asks to keep the room until 2 pm because their flight leaves at 7 pm.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I need something for a headache.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How often can I take it?

text: So 2 pils every 8 hrs, and max 6 a dya?
meaning: Speaker A confirms taking two 400 mg ibuprofen tablets every eight hours, with a maximum of six per day.

history.text: How do I get to Rundetaarn?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Gå ligeud, så kommer du til en stor kirke.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is there a bakery on the way too?

text: So I walk past it and then turn left?
meaning: Speaker A asks whether they should walk past the church and then turn left to reach Rundetaarn.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Thanks for showing me around today.

history.text: Do you have time before your train?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ja, en halv time eller så.

text: Gonna grab a coffee, wanna come? my treat
meaning: Speaker A invites B for coffee and offers to pay.

text: Great, I'll take the salon, half a kilo
meaning: Speaker A wants to buy half a kilo of salmon at 189 kroner per kilo.

text: how much to the airprot? i only have 300 kr cash
meaning: Speaker A asks the airport fare and says they only have 300 kroner in cash.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, I'm calling from my room.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Hej, hvad kan jeg hjælpe med?

text: 412. the AC is totally busted, can someone come up?
meaning: Speaker A in room 412 reports the air conditioning is broken and asks for someone to come fix it.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, what can I get for you?

text: Jeg tager to kilo kartofler og en flaske aeblemost
meaning: Speaker B buys two kilos of potatoes and one bottle of apple juice.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How much will it be to Frederiksberg?

text: Ja, det bliver 260 kr, kortlaeseren sidder pa bagsaedet
meaning: Speaker B says the fare is 260 kroner and the card reader is at the back seat.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Are any of the cakes gluten free?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Chokoladekagen er glutenfri, gulerodskagen er ikke.

text: Den har heller ingen æg, så den er sikker for dig
meaning: Speaker B says the chocolate cake also contains no eggs, so it is safe for A.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ja, det er inkluderet i prisen.

text: Morgenmaden er fra 7 til 10, i restaurnten på anden sal
meaning: Speaker B says breakfast is served from 7 to 10 in the restaurant on the second floor.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I have a prescription for antibiotics.

text: Tag en tablet tre gange om dagen efter maltidet, hojst i fem dage
meaning: Speaker B says to take one tablet three times a day after meals, for at most five days.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is the Glyptotek far from here?

text: Næh, det er lige om hjørnet, ik'. Fem min max
meaning: Speaker B says no bus is needed; the Glyptotek is just around the corner, at most a five-minute walk.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Oh nice, I've always wanted to go!

text: Vil du med på lørdag? Vi kører kl. hal ti
meaning: Speaker B invites A to Skagen on Saturday, leaving at 9:30 (halv ti).

history.speaker: A
history.text: I need fever syrup for me and my daughter.

text: Hun må kun få halvdelen, altså 5 ml
meaning: Speaker B says the four-year-old daughter should get only half the adult dose, 5 ml.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Excuse me, where is the nearest supermarket?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Der er en Netto i nærheden.

text: Ga ned ad gaden, forbi kirken, og sa til hojre ved lyskrydset
meaning: Speaker B says to walk down the street, past the church, then turn right at the traffic lights to reach Netto.

text: Jeg har boet her i 12 år, men jeg er opvoket i Odense
meaning: Speaker B has lived in Copenhagen for 12 years but grew up in Odense.

text: Ill tkae two smal ones insted of the bsket
meaning: The English speaker will buy two small strawberry trays at 3.50 euros each instead of the 9-euro basket.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ja, vom Imker Becker aus dem Nachbardorf.

text: Der Waldhonig ist herber und kostet nur 7 Euro fur das Glas, der Kleehonig ist susser
meaning: The forest honey is more bitter and costs 7 euros per jar, while the clover honey is sweeter.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to the main station?

text: Can you drop me at the north entrance? It's closer to plateform 11
meaning: The passenger asks to be dropped at the station's north entrance because it is closer to platform 11.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is there a lot of traffic now?

text: Auf der A3 ist grad voll der Stau, ich fahr lieber über die Dörfer, passt scho
meaning: The driver says there is a big traffic jam on the A3 right now, so he will take back roads through the villages, and that is fine.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Das Satay-Huhn hat Erdnusssoße, aber das Curry nicht.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is the curry cooked in the same pan?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Nein, wir haben eine separate Pfanne.

text: Great, then I'll have it, but no sauce from the other one on the side please
meaning: The customer will order the curry and asks that none of the satay chicken's peanut sauce be served on the side.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I can't eat gluten. Is the soup safe?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Moment, ich frage in der Küche.

text: Die Suppe ist leider mit Mehl gebunden, aber der Salat mit Huhnchen ist glutenfrei, ohne Croutons naturlich
meaning: The soup is thickened with flour, but the chicken salad is gluten-free if served without croutons.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, I have a reservation under Morgan.

text: Coud I get a late chekout on the last day, maybe 1pm?
meaning: The guest asks for a late checkout at 1 pm on the final day.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The air conditioning in my room is loud.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Das tut mir leid. Wir haben noch Zimmer 508 frei.

text: Es hat aber keinen Balkon, Ihres schon. Wollen Sie trotzdem wechseln?
meaning: Room 508 has no balcony while the guest's current room does, so the clerk asks if the guest still wants to switch.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I need something for a headache.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ibuprofen 400, eine Tablette alle acht Stunden.

text: Gotcha, tbh my stomach's kinda wonky rn, is that gonna be an issue?
meaning: The customer understands, mentions their stomach is a bit upset right now, and asks if ibuprofen will be a problem.

history.speaker: A
history.text: My son has a cough. He is six.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ich empfehle diesen Hustensaft für Kinder.

text: Zweimal täglich 5 ml, morgns und abens, nicht lämger als eine Wohce
meaning: The child should take 5 ml twice a day, morning and evening, for no longer than one week.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Gehen Sie hier geradeaus bis zur Ampel.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Rechts, dann sehen Sie die Türme.

text: Is there a bakery on the way? I need to grab a pretzel before the toyr at 2
meaning: The tourist asks if there is a bakery along the way to buy a pretzel before the 2 o'clock tour.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I get to the Schiller Museum?

text: Linie 8 bis zur Haltestelle Marktplatz, dann noch funf Minuten zu Fuss uber die Brucke
meaning: Take tram line 8 to the Marktplatz stop, then walk five minutes across the bridge.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is this your first time at the festival?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Nein, ich komme seit zwölf Jahren hierher.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Wow. Which band is best tonight?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Die Band um 22 Uhr ist super.

text: No cap, I'm lowkey hyped, my buddy Theo's been bigging them up all week
meaning: The speaker is honestly quite excited because their friend Theo has been praising that band all week.

text: Zweimal im Jahr, meine Schwester Hanna hat dort ein kleines Cafe mit Blick aufs Meer und ich helfe im Sommer aus
meaning: The speaker visits twice a year because their sister Hanna runs a small café with a sea view there, and helps out in summer.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Der blaue ist Wolle, 25 Euro. Der rote ist Seide, 38 Euro.

text: Then I'll take that one, but can you hold the other one until Saturday?
meaning: The customer buys the blue wool scarf and asks the seller to reserve the red silk scarf until Saturday.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to Hotel Lindenhof?

text: Wir sind gleich da, das macht 23,80, Kartenzhalung geht leidr nur ab 30 Euor
meaning: They are almost there, the fare is 23.80 euros, and card payment is only possible from 30 euros.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Ramipril, 5 mg. I also want something for allergies.

text: Can I take it at the same time as them, or should I wait a few hours?
meaning: The customer asks whether the cetirizine can be taken at the same time as their ramipril blood pressure pills or whether they should wait a few hours.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is the hotel bar still open?

text: Ehrlich gesagt ist die Bar eher mau, geh lieber zur Kneipe ums Eck, da ist mega was los
meaning: The clerk says the hotel bar is honestly rather dull and suggests the pub around the corner, which is very lively.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Excuse me, where is the nearest pharmacy?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Die Apotheke am Rosenweg, etwa 300 Meter.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Nein, sonntags nur der Notdienst am Bahnhof.

text: How far is the one at the staton? Can I walk ther or shoud I take a bus?
meaning: The person asks how far the emergency pharmacy at the station is and whether to walk or take a bus.

history.speaker: A
history.text: What about the fish of the day?

text: Der Zander ist okay, aber die Soße hat Krabbenbutter, ich lasse sie weg und mache Zitrone dazu
meaning: The pike-perch is safe, but its sauce contains shrimp butter, so the server will leave the sauce off and add lemon instead.

text: Ill take thre kilos and a bunch of parsely
meaning: Customer A buys 3 kilos of tomatoes and one bunch of parsley.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to the port of Piraeus?

history.speaker: A
history.text: Gate E7, the ferry to Naxos.

text: Θα παρει περιπου σαραντα λεπτα με την κινηση, κοστιζει γυρω στα 35 ευρω
meaning: The taxi driver says the trip will take about 40 minutes with traffic and cost around 35 euros.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Is there milk in the béchamel?

text: My daughter cant have it at all, can you do the grilled sea bream for her instead?
meaning: The customer's daughter cannot have milk, so the customer asks for grilled sea bream for her instead of moussaka.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, we booked room 214 under Morrison.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Καλώς ήρθατε! Το 214 είναι στον δεύτερο όροφο.

text: Ναι ρε φίλε, άνετα, από 7 μέχρι 10, πάρε ό,τι γουστάρεις
meaning: The receptionist says breakfast is included, served from 7 to 10, and the guest can take whatever they like.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I need something for a sore throat.

text: How many can I take a dad? I'm also on lisinopril for blood pressure
meaning: Customer A asks how many lozenges they can take per day ('dad' is autocorrect for 'day') and says they take lisinopril for blood pressure.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Excuse me, where is the Acropolis Museum?

text: Ναι, περπατηστε ευθεια διακοσια μετρα και στριψτε δεξια στο φαρμακειο
meaning: The local tells A to walk straight for 200 meters and turn right at the pharmacy.

text: Nah, third time, we're obsessed tbh, this island is such a vibe

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ναι, μόλις ήρθαν από την Καλαμάτα.

text: Οκτώ ευτώ το κουτί, αλλά αν πάρεις δύο σου τα αφήνω δεκατέσσερα

history.text: Je peux vous en donner une nouvelle tout de suite.

text: Great, the other one can wait until we're back tonight, we're going out now
meaning: The guest says the shower repair can wait until they return tonight because they are leaving now.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is breakfast included with the room?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Oui, de sept heures à dix heures trente.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is it worth getting up for?

text: Franchement c'est ouf, les croissants sont de la boulangerie Peyrac, ça vaut grave le coup
meaning: The receptionist says breakfast is excellent, with croissants from the Peyrac bakery, and is very worth it.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I need something for a bad cough.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ce sirop, 15 ml le soir. Vous prenez d'autres médicaments ?

text: Yes, blood presure pills, one 5mg tablet evry morning
meaning: The customer takes one 5 mg blood pressure tablet every morning.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How often can my son take this ibuprofen? He is eight.

text: Alors une dose de 7 ml toutes les huit heures, pas plus de trois par jour, et apres le repas
meaning: The child should take 7 ml every eight hours, no more than three doses a day, after meals.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Excuse me, where is the Musée d'Orsay?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Suivez la Seine vers l'ouest, c'est à vingt minutes à pied.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Le RER C, station Musée d'Orsay.

text: Thanks, I'll walk then, my feet are fine and I want to sea the river
meaning: The tourist will walk to the museum because they want to see the river (autocorrected 'see' to 'sea').

history.speaker: A
history.text: Where can I find a supermarket near here?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Il y a un Monoprix rue Lepic.

text: Nan, c'est à deux pas, tu tournes à gauche au tabac et t'es dessus direct
meaning: It is very close: turn left at the tobacco shop and the supermarket is right there.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is this your first time in Lyon too?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Non, j'habite ici depuis neuf ans.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Oh nice, I'm here for a conference.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Vous aimez la ville pour l'instant ?

text: Honestly it slaps, the food is insane, I'm lowkey thinking of moving here lol
meaning: The visitor loves the city and its food and is half-seriously considering moving there.

history.speaker: A
history.text: My sister and my brother-in-law are coming to Marseille next week.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Super ! Ils restent combien de temps ?

history.speaker: A
history.text: Ten days. She loves swimming, he hates the beach.

text: Alors emmène-la aux calanques, et lui, envoie-le au Vieux-Port manger une bouillabaisse
meaning: Take the sister to the calanques to swim, and send the brother-in-law to the Old Port for bouillabaisse.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How much for the leather wallet and the scarf?

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you do a better price on the wallet?

text: Deal for that one, but I'll skip the other, it's not really her color
meaning: The buyer accepts the wallet at 38 euros but declines the scarf because it doesn't suit the recipient.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you drop me at the Hôtel Bellecour?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Oui. Vous payez en carte ou en espèces ?

text: Pas de souci, mais le terminal est en panne, il faudra passer au distributeur de billets à côté du château
meaning: The card terminal is broken so the passenger must use the cash machine nearby; 'château' is likely an autocorrect error for 'chantier' or similar landmark.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hello, I have a reservation under Okafor.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Oui, une chambre double pour trois nuits.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can I check out late on the last day?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Jusqu'à quatorze heures, avec un supplément de 20 euros.

text: Thats fine, and can you keep my luggag after that untill 6pm?
meaning: The guest accepts the late checkout fee and asks if the hotel can hold their luggage until 6 pm.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I'm gluten intolerant. Which pastries are safe?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Presque tout contient du blé ici.

text: Les macarons sont sans gluten, mais ils sont prepares a cote de la farine, donc il y a un risque
meaning: The macarons are gluten-free but are prepared near flour, so there is a cross-contamination risk.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The doctor gave me antibiotics and a cream for this rash.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Les antibiotiques, un comprimé matin et soir pendant six jours.

history.speaker: A
history.text: And how do I use the cream?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Une fine couche deux fois par jour.

text: Should I stop it once the rash is gone, or keep going?
meaning: The patient asks whether to stop applying the cream once the rash disappears.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I get to the Jardin des Plantes?

history.speaker: A
history.text: Yes, but I can take a bus.

text: Prennez le bus 67, descendez au troisème arêt, et c'est en face de la pharmacie
meaning: Take bus 67, get off at the third stop, and the garden is across from the pharmacy.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, are these tomatoes fresh today?

history.speaker: B
history.text: હા, આજે સવારે જ આવ્યા છે. કિલોના ૫૦ રૂપિયા.

text: ok giv me 2 kilo tomatos, can u do 90 for both kilos?
meaning: The customer wants 2 kg of tomatoes and asks to pay 90 rupees total instead of 100.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Do you have mangoes? Kesar ones?

text: ડઝનન ૬૦૦ પણ તમન ૫૫૦ મ આપસ
meaning: The vendor says Kesar mangoes are 600 rupees a dozen but will give them to the customer for 550.

text: no worries, just gotta be there by 4 tho, train's at 4:20 lol
meaning: The passenger is fine with the delay but must arrive by 4:00 because the train leaves at 4:20.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Will you use the meter or a fixed price?

text: મીઠું ચાલુ છે, લગભગ ૧૮૦ થશે
meaning: The driver says the meter (autocorrected to 'salt') is running and the fare will be about 180 rupees.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Does the dal have peanuts? I'm allergic.

history.speaker: B
history.text: ના, દાળમાં નથી. પણ ચટણીમાં સીંગ છે.

history.speaker: B
history.text: કઢીમાં નથી, ખાલી દહીં અને બેસન.

text: Great, but please keep it off my plate, my son is allergic too.
meaning: The customer asks the server to keep the peanut chutney off his plate because his son is also allergic.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I can't eat gluten. Is the thepla okay?

text: બાજરનો રોટલો ખાય સકો, એમા ઘઉ નથ. સાથે રીંગણનુ શાક
meaning: The waiter says the customer can eat bajra rotlo, which has no wheat, with eggplant curry.

text: Thanks. Can we get a late checkout, like 1 pm? And an extra pillar for my wife's back
meaning: The guest asks for a 1 pm late checkout and an extra pillow (autocorrected to 'pillar') for his wife's back.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The AC in my room isn't working.

text: સોરી હોં, હમણાં જ માણસ મોકલું, દસ મિનિટમાં ટાઢું થઈ જશે, ટેન્શન નઈ લેવાનું
meaning: The staff member apologizes, is sending someone now, says the room will be cool in ten minutes, and tells the guest not to worry.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Something for fever for my daughter, she's 6.

history.speaker: A
history.text: આ સીરપ આપું, ૫ મિલી દિવસમાં ત્રણ વાર.

text: ok and if the fevr is still ther after 48 hrs shud i bring her bak?
meaning: The parent asks whether to bring the daughter back if her fever continues after 48 hours.

history.speaker: A
history.text: My doctor prescribed this antibiotic. How should I take it?

text: સવરે અન સજે એક એક ગોળ, જમય પછ, સાત દવસ સધ
meaning: The pharmacist says to take one tablet in the morning and one in the evening, after meals, for seven days.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is Lal Darwaja far from here?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ના, ચાલીને ૧૫ મિનિટ. સીધા જઈને મસ્જિદ પાસે ડાબે.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is there a bank near the mosque?

history.speaker: B
history.text: હા, મસ્જિદની સામે બેંક ઓફ બરોડા છે.

text: Is it open on Sundays? I need cash.
meaning: The tourist asks whether the Bank of Baroda branch opposite the mosque is open on Sundays because he needs cash.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I get to Kankaria Lake?

text: ચાલીને તો બહુ લાંબુ પડશે બોસ, એકાદ કલાક. શટલમાં બેસી જાવ, ૨૦ રૂપિયામાં પતી જશે
meaning: Walking would take about an hour, so the local suggests taking a shared rickshaw, which costs 20 rupees.

history.speaker: B
history.text: From Toronto. First time in Gujarat.

text: not yet but def gonna, heard Navratri here is lit af
meaning: The visitor has not seen garba yet but definitely will, having heard Navratri in Gujarat is amazing.

history.speaker: A
history.text: મારો દીકરો અને દીકરી બંને અમેરિકામાં છે.

history.speaker: A
history.text: દીકરો શિકાગોમાં અને દીકરી ન્યુ જર્સીમાં.

text: દીકરી તો દર દિવાળીએ આવે, પણ એ ચાર વર્ષથી નથી આવ્યો
meaning: The daughter visits every Diwali, but the son (masculine verb) has not come in four years.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How much is this blue bandhani dupatta?

history.speaker: A
history.text: And the red one with mirrors?

text: That's too much. Can you do 600 for it?
meaning: The customer finds the red mirror-work dupatta too expensive and offers 600 rupees for it.

text: એક ગ્રામના ૩૨૦, અસલી કાશ્મીરી છે, ચાવી જુઓ
meaning: The vendor says one gram is 320 rupees, it is genuine Kashmiri saffron, and invites the customer to taste it ('chakhi' was autocorrected to 'chavi').

text: yes, can u wait there 5 mins? need to pick up my mob
meaning: The passenger asks the driver to wait 5 minutes in Vastrapur to pick up his mom ('mom' was autocorrected to 'mob').

history.speaker: B
history.text: Is the pav bhaji made with butter?

history.speaker: A
history.text: હા, અમૂલ બટર. ઘણું બટર નાખીએ.

text: im lactose intolrant, can u make it with oil insted, no paneer eithr
meaning: The customer is lactose intolerant and asks for the pav bhaji to be made with oil and without paneer.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I have a headache and my stomach is upset.

history.speaker: B
history.text: આ માથાના દુખાવાની ગોળી છે, અને આ પેટ માટે પાવડર.

text: આ પાણીમાં ઓગાળીને પીવો, સવારે અને રાત્રે; એ તો દુખે ત્યારે જ એક લેવી
meaning: Dissolve the stomach powder in water and drink it morning and night, and take one headache tablet only when the head hurts.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is it always this hot in May?

history.speaker: B
history.text: હા, મે માં બહુ ગરમી હોય.

text: જુનના છેલા અઠવાડીયામા ચોમાસુ બેસે, પછી મજા આવસે
meaning: The monsoon starts in the last week of June, and after that the weather will be pleasant.

text: Ill take two baskets for 7500 if you agre
meaning: The buyer offers 7,500 naira for two baskets of tomatoes, if the seller agrees.

text: Daya naira dari takwas, amma manya sun kare
meaning: One yam costs 800 naira, but the big ones are sold out.

text: Nah bro, that's a rip-off, do 6k and we roll
meaning: The passenger rejects 7,000 naira as too high and offers 6,000 naira for the ride to the airport.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you stop at the bank first?

history.speaker: A
history.text: The one near Kofar Mata gate.

text: Ba zan iya jira a gabansa ba, sai dai na ajiye ka a bayansa.
meaning: The driver can't wait in front of the bank near Kofar Mata, but can drop the passenger behind the bank.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Miyar taushe ce, akwai gyaɗa a ciki.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ina da miyar kuka ba tare da gyaɗa ba.

text: Great, give her that one, and no peanut oil in it either please
meaning: The parent asks the cook to serve the peanut-free kuka soup to Zainab, also made without peanut oil.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Is there any fish in the jollof?

history.speaker: B
history.text: And shrimp? I react badly to shellfish.

text: Babu jatan lande, amma an dafa shi a tukunya daya da kifi.
meaning: The jollof has no shrimp, but it was cooked in the same pot as fish.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Barka da zuwa Otal ɗin Tahir.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I booked a room for three nights.

text: Under Musa Bello, and I asked for twin breads not a double
meaning: The booking is under the name Musa Bello, and the guest requested twin beds instead of a double bed.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ƙarfe goma sha biyu na rana.

text: Ba matsala bro, amma sai ka ƙara dubu biyu da ɗari biyar, ka gane ko?
meaning: The guest may stay until 1 pm but must pay an extra 2,500 naira.

text: How many ml do I giv him and how ofen?
meaning: The parent asks how many milliliters of paracetamol syrup to give the four-year-old son and how often.

history.speaker: A
history.text: These are for my back pain?

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I take these tablets?

text: Kwaya daya sau uku a rana bayan abinci, kada ka wuce kwana bakwai
meaning: Take one tablet three times a day after meals, for no more than seven days.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Where is the Zoo Road post office?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ka wuce masallaci, ka juya hagu.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is the mosque the big one with green domes?

text: Ok, and is it on the left side of it or across from it?
meaning: The visitor asks whether the Zoo Road post office is to the left of the green-domed mosque or across from it.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I get to Sabon Gari market?

text: Ka bi wannan titin har ka ga gidan mai, sai ka yi damma
meaning: Follow this road until you see the fuel station, then turn right to reach Sabon Gari market.

text: Honestly it's lit, the food slaps
meaning: The visitor says Kano is great and the food is excellent.

history.speaker: B
history.text: A'a, ɗan uwana ne, sunansa Haruna.

history.speaker: A
history.text: And the lady next to him?

text: Matarsa ce, ita ce ta dafa mana abincin nan.
meaning: The lady is Haruna's wife, and she is the one who cooked this food for us.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Yadi shida, naira dubu goma sha biyar.

text: Can you do 12,000 and throw in the read one too?
meaning: The buyer offers 12,000 naira for the six yards of Holland fabric and asks for the red one to be added free.

text: Na waje ne, used, amma ƙalau suke, guarantee wata uku.
meaning: The phones are used imports from abroad, in good condition, with a three-month guarantee.

text: Can you stpo at a pharmcy on the way, I'll be quick
meaning: The passenger asks the driver to stop briefly at a pharmacy on the way to Bompai Road.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is the road to the stadium busy?

text: Kamar minti arba'in, sai mun bi ta kofar Nassarawa saboda cunkoso
meaning: The trip will take about 40 minutes, going via the Nassarawa gate because of traffic.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The shower in room 214 isn't working.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Yi haƙuri, zan aika mai gyara.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Also the AC remote is missing.

text: Thanks, can he bring it when he comes to fix it?
meaning: The guest asks if the repairman can bring the new AC remote when he comes to fix the shower in room 214.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I can't eat gluten. Is the masa ok?

text: Babu alkama ko kadan, sai dai muna soya ta a mai iri daya da fanke
meaning: The rice masa has no wheat at all, but it is fried in the same oil as the wheat puff-puff (fanke).

text: ok gimme 2 kilo tomatos and one of cucmbers
meaning: The customer wants 2 kilograms of tomatoes and 1 kilogram of cucumbers.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Too much. Can you do less?

text: אחי, זה מציאה, בשבילך שלושים וחמש וזהו, סוגרים?
meaning: The vendor offers the scarf for a final price of 35 shekels and asks if it's a deal.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to Dizengoff Center?

history.speaker: A
history.text: My friend is waiting near the fountain there.

text: Can you wait for her there? She'll bring the suitcase.
meaning: The passenger asks the driver to wait for the female friend at the fountain, who will bring the suitcase.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How much to the central bus station?

text: זה יוצא בערך שבעים שקל, עם המונה, מתאים לחה?
meaning: The driver says it comes to about 70 shekels on the meter and asks if that works for the passenger.

history.speaker: B
history.text: יש בו רוטב טחינה ואגוזי מלך.

text: I'm allergic to walnuts, can you make it without? Dressing on the slide is fine
meaning: The diner is allergic to walnuts, wants the salad without them, and is fine with the dressing on the side.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Does the schnitzel have any dairy? My son can't have milk.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Thanks, it's serious, he gets hives.

text: בדקתי, היא מטוגנת בשמן, אבל הפירורים עם חמאה, אז לא בשבילו
meaning: The schnitzel is fried in oil but its breadcrumbs contain butter, so it is not suitable for the son.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, I have a reservation under Morgan.

text: great, can i get a late chekout on the last day, like 1pm?
meaning: The guest asks for a late checkout at 1 pm on the last day.

history.speaker: A
history.text: We have no towels in the bathroom.

text: סליחה! אני שולחת מישהי עם מגבעות נקיות תוך רבע שעה
meaning: The receptionist apologizes and is sending someone with clean towels to room 412 within 15 minutes.

history.speaker: A
history.text: My daughter has a fever, she's 7.

text: And my husband has a cold, can he take it too or does he need something else?
meaning: The mother asks whether her husband can take the same children's Acamol syrup or needs a different medicine.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The doctor gave me this prescription for antibiotics.

history.speaker: B
history.text: כן, הנה. אתה לוקח עוד תרופות?

text: קח כדור אחד פעמיים בימ אחרי האוכל, לא יותר משבועיים
meaning: The pharmacist says to take one pill twice a day after meals, for no more than two weeks.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Excuse me, where's the Carmel Market?

history.speaker: B
history.text: תמשיך ישר עד הרמזור ואז שמאלה.

text: cool, is there an ATM on the way? gotta grab cash, I'm totally broke
meaning: The tourist asks if there is an ATM on the way to Carmel Market because he has no cash.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I'm looking for the post office on Herzl Street.

history.speaker: B
history.text: יש שם שתיים, אחת ליד הבנק ואחת ליד הגן.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The one that's open on Friday.

text: זאת ליד הגן, היא פתוחה עד אחת. תעבור את הבנק ותמשיך עוד שלושה בניינים.
meaning: The post office by the park is open Friday until 1 pm; pass the bank and continue three more buildings.

history.speaker: B
history.text: וואו, רחוק! כמה זמן אתה בארץ?

text: Just landed yesterday, staying four weeks, then heading to Eilat with my bother
meaning: The traveler landed yesterday, is staying four weeks, and will then go to Eilat with his brother.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is this your first time at a Maccabi game?

history.speaker: B
history.text: מה פתאום, אני בא כל שבוע.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Nice! Who's going to win tonight?

text: וואלה, אם החלוץ לא יעשה פדיחות, אנחנו לוקחים את זה בקלילות, סבבה?
meaning: The fan says that if the striker doesn't embarrass himself, Maccabi will win easily.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I'd like some cheese and olives.

text: Great, give me half a kilo of it, and the black ones, just a small box
meaning: The customer wants half a kilo of the Galilee goat cheese and a small box of black olives.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I'm in a hurry, I have a train at 5:15.

text: יאללה, הפקק פה מטורף, אני חותך דרך איילון, תביא לי עשרים דקות, סבבה?
meaning: The driver says traffic is terrible, he will cut through the Ayalon highway, and asks for 20 minutes to get there.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Do you have something for heartburn?

history.speaker: B
history.text: שתיים בכל פעם, עד עשר ביום.

text: ok and is it safe while pregant? im in my 26th week
meaning: The customer asks if the chewable heartburn tablets are safe during pregnancy, as she is 26 weeks pregnant.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, we just checked in to room 233.

history.speaker: A
history.text: What time is breakfast, and where?

text: ארוחת הבוקר מוגשת בקומה התחונה מ-6:30 עד 9:45
meaning: Breakfast is served on the bottom floor from 6:30 to 9:45.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Yes, how do I get to the Western Wall?

history.speaker: B
history.text: תיכנס בשער יפו ותלך דרך השוק.

text: Thanks! Is the shuk open on Saturday or closed for Shabbat? My wife wants to buy spies
meaning: The tourist asks whether the Old City market is open on Saturday because his wife wants to buy spices.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I have celiac, is the shakshuka gluten-free?

history.speaker: B
history.text: השקשוקה כן, אבל היא מגיעה עם לחם.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can I get it without bread?

text: בטח, אני אבקש מהשף להחליף את הלחם בסלע, זה בלי תוספת מחיר
meaning: The waiter will ask the chef to replace the bread with salad at no extra charge.
