text: How much do I give him, and how often?
meaning: The parent asks how much paracetamol syrup to give the 7-year-old son and how often.

history.speaker: A
history.text: What's the dose for these tablets?

text: ਇਕ ਗੋਲੀ ਦਿਨ ਵਿਚ ਦੋ ਵਾਰ, ਰੋਟੀ ਤੋ ਬਾਅਦ, ਪਜ ਦਿਨ
meaning: The pharmacist says the adult should take one tablet twice a day after meals for five days.

text: Sweet, gonna hoof it then. Any good chai spot on the way?
meaning: The tourist will walk the 10 minutes there and asks for a good tea stall along the way.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I get to the bus stand?

text: ਦੂਜੀ ਲਾਇਟ ਤੋਂ ਸਜੇ ਮੁੜਜੋ, ਪੈਟਰੋਲ ਪੰਪ ਦੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਆ
meaning: The local says to turn right at the second traffic light; the bus stand is opposite the petrol pump.

text: Love it! The food is amazing but the trafficking here is insane
meaning: The visitor loves Punjab, finds the food amazing, and thinks the traffic is crazy.

history.speaker: A
history.text: What do you do for work?

text: ਕਣਕ ਤੇ ਝੋਨਾ, ਬੱਸ ਐਤਕੀਂ ਮੀਂਹ ਨੇ ਪੱਟ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਯਾਰ
meaning: The farmer grows wheat and paddy but says this year the rain ruined things.

text: C'mon, that's a rip-off. Nine hundred and I'm sold
meaning: The buyer rejects 1100 rupees and offers 900 for the shawl.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I'll take the red bangles and the blue ones.

history.speaker: B
history.text: ਲਾਲ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਡੇਢ ਸੌ ਦੀਆਂ, ਨੀਲੀਆਂ ਢਾਈ ਸੌ ਦੀਆਂ।

history.speaker: A
history.text: Why are the blue ones more expensive?

text: ਉਹ ਕੱਚ ਦੀਆਂ ਨੇ, ਇਹ ਤਾਂ ਪਲਾਸਟਿਕ ਦੀਆਂ
meaning: The seller explains that the blue bangles (250) are glass and the red ones (150) are plastic.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is there egg in this cake?

history.speaker: A
history.text: My daughter is allergic to eggs.

history.speaker: B
history.text: ਸਾਡੇ ਕੋਲ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਆਂਡੇ ਵਾਲਾ ਵੀ ਹੈ।

text: realy? is it 100% egless? she had a reacton last time at a bakery
meaning: The parent asks if the eggless cake is completely egg-free because the daughter had a reaction at a bakery before.

history.speaker: B
history.text: ਇੱਥੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਰੁਕ ਸਕਦੇ, ਪੁਲਿਸ ਹੈ।

text: ਅਗੇ ਚੌਕ ਤੋ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਰੋਕ ਦੂਗਾ, ਕਿਰਾਇਆ ਇਕ ਸੌ ਸਤਰ ਹੋਇਆ
meaning: The driver will stop just before the next intersection, and the fare is 170 rupees.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Do you have something for an upset stomach?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ਇਹ ਓ.ਆਰ.ਐੱਸ. ਲਓ ਅਤੇ ਇਹ ਗੋਲੀ।

text: Can I take it with my blood pleasure medicine?
meaning: The customer asks if the stomach tablet is safe to take with their blood pressure medicine.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is there a good place to eat near the hotel?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ਹਾਂ, ਗਲੀ ਦੇ ਮੋੜ 'ਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਢਾਬਾ ਹੈ।

text: ਸਿਰਾ ਆ ਜੀ, ਮੈਂ ਆਪ ਉੱਥੇ ਰੋਜ਼ ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਂਦਾਂ, ਸਰ੍ਹੋਂ ਦਾ ਸਾਗ ਤਾਂ ਕਮਾਲ ਆ
meaning: The staff member says the dhaba is excellent, he eats there every day, and the mustard greens are amazing.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, are these plums from Poland?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Tak, prosto z sadu pod Grójcem.

text: how mcuh for teh plums, like 1.5 kilo?
meaning: The customer asks the price for 1.5 kilograms of plums.

text: can u hang a left at the lights? im kinda in a rush lol
meaning: The passenger asks the driver to turn left at the traffic lights because they are in a hurry.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I'm allergic to walnuts. Is the cake safe?

history.speaker: A
history.text: Great. What about the pierogi with the sweet sauce?

history.speaker: B
history.text: To pierogi z jagodami i sosem śmietanowym.

text: Does it have them in it too?
meaning: The customer asks whether the sweet sauce on the pierogi also contains walnuts.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Dzień dobry, w czym mogę pomóc?

history.speaker: A
history.text: I'm in room 214, checking out tomorrow.

text: Can I get a late check out at 3 pm? My fight is at 8
meaning: The guest asks for a late checkout at 3 pm because their flight is at 8.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I need something for a bad cough.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Polecam te tabletki, są bez recepty.

text: so i take 3 pils evry 12 hrs rihgt?
meaning: The customer confirms the dose is three pills every twelve hours.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Excuse me, is there a Rossmann near here?

text: Is it before or after the bridge?
meaning: The tourist asks whether the Rossmann store is before or after the bridge.

history.speaker: B
history.text: I jak się panu podoba Kraków?

text: ngl its lowkey awesome, but the heat is wild, it hit 34 yesterday
meaning: The visitor says Kraków is great but the heat is extreme, reaching 34 degrees yesterday.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I'll take some of the yellow one too.

text: Can you slice it thin? Not the hole block
meaning: The customer asks for the gouda to be sliced thin rather than sold as a whole block.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Two stops please. My friend Kasia is going to Mokotów.

text: Can you drop her off first, then me?
meaning: The passenger asks the driver to drop Kasia off in Mokotów first and then take him to the hotel.

history.speaker: A
history.text: What kind of soup is it?

text: I'm allergic to shellfish, is the soap made with shrimp?
meaning: The diner, who has a shellfish allergy, asks if the soup contains shrimp.

text: Malinowe sa po 9 zl za kilo, ale dzis dam taniej
meaning: The vendor says the pink tomatoes cost 9 złoty per kilo but she will give a discount today.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Chopin. How long will it take?

text: Okolo 25 minut, moze wiecej przez korki na Zwirki
meaning: The driver says the trip takes about 25 minutes, maybe more due to traffic on Żwirki i Wigury street.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I have a severe peanut allergy.

text: Luzik, kucharz mówi że w sałatce nie ma ani grama orzeszków, git
meaning: The waiter reassures the diner that the cook confirmed the chicken salad contains no peanuts at all.

history.speaker: A
history.text: We're checking out, but our train is at night.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Great, I just have this big backpack.

text: Może pan go zostawić w recepcji do wieczora
meaning: The receptionist says the guest can leave his backpack at reception until the evening.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Dla pani czy dla kogoś innego?

history.speaker: A
history.text: For me. How do I take it?

text: Prosze brac jedna tabletke dwa razy dziennie po jedzeniu
meaning: The pharmacist says to take one tablet twice a day after meals.

text: Tak, prsoto do ronda, potem w lweo, apteka jest za Żabką
meaning: The local says to go straight to the roundabout, then turn left, and the pharmacy is past the Żabka shop.

text: Wczoraj byłam na koncercie, sztos, ale nie ogarniam dzisiaj nic
meaning: She says she went to an amazing concert last night and can't function at all today.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is this fever syrup okay for my son? He's four.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Tak, jest dla dzieci od dwóch lat.

text: Dla dziecka pół łyżwy co sześć godzin, nie więcej niż cztery razy na dobę
meaning: The pharmacist says the child should take half a teaspoon every six hours, at most four times a day.

text: Sniadanie jest od 7 do 10:30 na pierwszym pietrze
meaning: The receptionist says breakfast is served from 7 to 10:30 on the first floor.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I'm looking for the tram stop to Nowa Huta.

text: Przystanek jest zaraz za nią, po prawej
meaning: The local says the tram stop to Nowa Huta is just behind the two-towered cathedral, on the right.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, are these almonds from Kandahar?

history.speaker: B
history.text: هو، دا د کندهار بادام دي، ډېر تازه دي.

text: How much for 3 kilos? Ill give 900 afgahnis tops
meaning: The buyer asks the price of 3 kilos of almonds and offers at most 900 afghanis.

history.speaker: B
history.text: سمه ده، کېنه. لاره نن ګڼه ده.

text: Can you step on it? I'm gonna miss my flight at 6
meaning: The passenger asks the driver to hurry because their flight leaves at 6.

history.speaker: B
history.text: بانجان، رومي، او پاسه يې غوز او ماسته ده.

text: Can you take them out? My son's allergic
meaning: The customer asks the waiter to leave the walnuts out of the eggplant dish because their son is allergic.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hello, I have a reservation under Miller.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Thanks. Quick question about the rate.

text: Is breakfast included? I'm checking out on Thirsty
meaning: The guest in room 214 asks whether breakfast is included and says they check out on Thursday.

history.speaker: B
history.text: دا انټي بیوټیک دی، د معدې لپاره سخت دی.

history.speaker: A
history.text: So I should take it with food?

history.speaker: B
history.text: هو، ورځ کې دوه ځله، هر ځل دوه ګولۍ، پنځه ورځې.

text: So 2 pills twice a day aftr meals, for 5 days rite?
meaning: The customer confirms the dose: 2 antibiotic pills twice a day after meals for 5 days.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Where is the Haji Karim mosque?

history.speaker: B
history.text: نېغ لاړ شه، یو پل به ووینې.

history.speaker: B
history.text: هو، جومات هم هلته نږدې دی.

text: Is it before or after the bridge?
meaning: The tourist asks whether the Haji Karim mosque is before or after the bridge.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Not yet. Do you have a big family?

history.speaker: B
history.text: هو، زه اووه وروڼه او خویندې لرم.

text: No way, you've got 7 siblings? That's wild
meaning: The speaker is amazed that the other person has 7 siblings.

history.speaker: A
history.text: They're a bit big for me.

history.speaker: B
history.text: نور رنګونه هم لرو، تور او شین.

text: Do you have smaller ones? The blue ones look grate
meaning: The shopper asks for the sandals in a smaller size and says the blue ones look great.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Take me to Wazir Akbar Khan hospital.

history.speaker: B
history.text: روغتون دوه دروازې لري، یوه مخې ته، بله شاته.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Which one is near the emergency room?

text: Drop me at the second one, not the first
meaning: The passenger wants to be dropped at the hospital's second (rear) gate near emergency, not the front gate.

history.speaker: B
history.text: دا شربت لس ملي لیتره د شپې واخله.

text: This cough is killing me, got anything stronger that knocks it out?
meaning: The customer says the cough is very bad and asks for something stronger than the 10 ml night syrup.

history.speaker: B
history.text: هو، دا د قندهار انار دي.

text: دا انار ډیر سه دي، دوه کیلو په ۲۵۰ درکوم
meaning: The seller says the pomegranates are very good and offers 2 kilos for 250 afghanis.

history.speaker: B
history.text: د مزار د موټرو اډې ته.

text: ز باید تر ۷ بجو ادې ته ورسيږم
meaning: The passenger says they must reach the bus station by 7 o'clock.

history.speaker: A
history.text: My daughter is allergic to peanuts.

history.speaker: B
history.text: بولاني پاکه ده، خو ورسره چټني هم راځي.

text: هو، خو په هغې کې مومپلي دي، ورته لاس مه وروړئ
meaning: The waiter says the bolani is safe but the chutney contains peanuts, so the daughter should not touch it.

history.speaker: A
history.text: There's no hot water in room 308.

text: یاره د ګرمو اوبو ماشین ټپه ولاړ دی، تر سبا صبر وکړه
meaning: The receptionist says the water heater for room 308 is completely dead and asks the guest to wait until tomorrow.

history.speaker: A
history.text: This is for my mother, she's 70.

history.speaker: B
history.text: د زړو لپاره کم دوز ښه دی.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How often should she take it?

text: د ورځې دري زله، هر زل نیمه ګولی
meaning: The pharmacist says the mother should take half a tablet three times a day.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I get to Shar-e Naw park?

text: سیده لاړ سه، په دویم چوک کی سی لاس ته وګرزه
meaning: Go straight and turn right at the second roundabout to reach Shar-e Naw park.

text: نه، زه د جلال اباد یم خو اوس په هرات کې اوسیدم
meaning: The speaker is from Jalalabad but now lives in Herat (autocorrect turned 'live' into 'lived').

history.speaker: B
history.text: یو سور دی، بل شین، دواړه وړین دي.

text: نه، هغه سور یې ۴۸۰ دی، دا بل یې ارزان دی
meaning: The red scarf costs 480 afghanis and the green one is cheaper.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The meter says 340, but I only have 300 in cash.

text: وروره پروا نه کوي، ۳۰۰ راکړه بس دی
meaning: The driver says no problem, 300 afghanis is enough.

text: ناشته له ۶ نه تر ۹ پوري ده، په دوهم پور کي
meaning: Breakfast is served from 6 to 9 on the second floor.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Três reais cada, ou cinco por doze.

history.speaker: B
history.text: A papaia está a quatro reais.

text: ok ill tkae four mangos and two papayas pls
meaning: A wants to buy four mangoes and two papayas.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to the airport?

text: Fine, but can you take the toll rode? My flight is at 9:40
meaning: A agrees to the fare and asks the driver to take the toll road (not 'rode') because the flight is at 9:40.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Sim, tem camarão e leite de coco.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Esse vem só com limão e sal.

text: I'll get that one then, I'm allergic to shellfish.
meaning: A orders the grilled fish, not the moqueca, because A is allergic to shellfish.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Bem-vindo! O café da manhã está incluído.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Great, what time does it start?

text: Cool, gonna crash early tonight, can I get a wake-up call at 6:15?
meaning: A plans to go to sleep early and requests a wake-up call at 6:15.

history.speaker: A
history.text: My son has a fever. What do you recommend?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ibuprofeno infantil em gotas é uma boa opção.

history.speaker: B
history.text: A dose depende do peso da criança.

text: how mnay drops for a 7 yr old, he weighs like 22 kilos
meaning: A asks how many drops to give a seven-year-old son who weighs about 22 kilos.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Siga em frente e vire na Rua do Alecrim.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is there a metro stop near it?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Sim, Cais do Sodré, a duas quadras.

text: Is it open on Sundays or just weekdays?
meaning: A asks whether the Mercado da Ribeira (not the metro stop) is open on Sundays or only on weekdays.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Claro, sou do Porto desde criança.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Did you watch the game yesterday?

text: lol no way, Benfica got wrecked last night, my buddy lost 50 euros betting
meaning: A says Benfica lost badly last night and A's friend lost 50 euros betting on the game.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Temos queijo da Serra fresco e um curado de doze meses.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can I try the aged one?

text: Can I get 300 grams of the aged one, sliced thing?
meaning: A wants 300 grams of the twelve-month aged cheese, sliced thin ('thing' is autocorrect for 'thin').

history.speaker: A
history.text: I need to buy medicine on the way.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Tem uma farmácia ali na esquina.

text: pls stop at the farmacy on teh corner, ill be 3 min
meaning: A asks the driver to stop at the pharmacy on the corner and says A will be back in three minutes.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The air conditioner in room 418 isn't working.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Vou mandar alguém. Quer trocar de quarto?

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is the other room on a higher floor?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Sim, o quarto 702, com vista para o mar.

text: Ok I'll take it, but can someone bring my bags up there?
meaning: A accepts room 702 and asks for someone to carry A's bags from room 418 up to room 702.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I need something for a sore throat.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Syrup, please. It's for an adult.

text: Tome 10 ml tres vezes ao dia, depois das refeicoes, no maximo cinco dias
meaning: B tells A to take 10 ml of syrup three times a day after meals, for no more than five days.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I get to the art museum?

history.speaker: B
history.text: É perto, dá para ir a pé.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Desça esta rua até a padaria.

text: Voce vira a esquerda na padaria e o museu fica do lado direito, perto da estacao
meaning: B says to turn left at the bakery, and the museum is on the right side, near the station.

history.speaker: A
history.text: And the smaller one next to it?

text: Pode levar, tá baratinho, faço os dois por quinze conto
meaning: B offers both bags, the big one and the smaller one, together for 15 reais, saying it's a cheap deal.

text: Vai demorar uns 25 minutos, o tranzito ta parado na ponte
meaning: B says the ride will take about 25 minutes because traffic is stopped on the bridge.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I can't eat peanuts. Are the cakes safe?

text: Esse não leva, mas é feito na mesma cozinha que o outro.
meaning: B says the carrot cake has no peanuts but is made in the same kitchen as the chocolate cake, which does.

history.speaker: A
history.text: We're checking out now, but our train is in the evening.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can we leave our suitcases somewhere?

text: Pode deixar as mulas aqui na recepção, guardamos até as 16h
meaning: B says A can leave the suitcases ('mulas' is autocorrect for 'malas') at reception, and they will be kept until 4 p.m.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Did you go to the concert last night?

history.speaker: A
history.text: How was it? I almost went.

text: Mano, o show ontem foi top demais, bora no próximo sábado?
meaning: B says last night's concert was amazing and invites A to go together next Saturday.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I have two prescriptions: amoxicillin and a nasal spray.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Do I need to use them with food?

text: O antibiótico sim, de 8 em 8 horas. O outro é só duas vezes ao dia.
meaning: B says to take the amoxicillin with food every 8 hours, and to use the nasal spray only twice a day.

text: Esse peixe e fresquinho, chegou hoje. O quilo ta 38 reais, quer que eu limpe?
meaning: B says the sea bass arrived today, costs 38 reais per kilo, and offers to clean it.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I get to the Lapa neighborhood?

history.speaker: A
history.text: Yes, I was planning to walk.

text: Ih, é longe pra caramba a pé, pega o busão 714 ali no ponto
meaning: B says Lapa is very far on foot and advises A to take bus 714 from the stop nearby.

text: Ill take two kilo of tomatos and one of the pepers
meaning: The customer wants 2 kg of tomatoes and 1 kg of peppers.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is this cheese made from sheep's milk?

text: Sigur, dar e cam sarata, va dau o bucatica
meaning: The vendor agrees, warns that the sheep cheese is rather salty, and gives the customer a small piece.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Yes, a suitcase and a backpack.

text: Keep it with me, it has my laptop.
meaning: The passenger wants to keep the backpack with them because their laptop is in it.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Până la Otopeni, cam 90 de lei.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you go faster? My flight is at 5:40.

text: Stai lejer, ajungem fix, nu-i bai
meaning: The driver tells the passenger to relax because they will arrive on time and it is no problem.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ciorba nu are nuci, dar desertul are.

text: I'm allergic to sesame so no salad, just the soap please
meaning: The diner is allergic to sesame, so they skip the salad and order only the soup.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is there something else for him?

text: Avem papanasi fara oua, ii facem special pt el
meaning: The waiter says they can make egg-free papanași specially for the son.

history.speaker: A
history.text: We booked a double room for three nights.

text: Can we get a late chekout on the last day, arond 1pm?
meaning: The guests ask for a late checkout at about 1 pm on their last day.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The shower in our room is not working.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Îmi pare rău. Trimit pe cineva.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Also the key card stopped working.

text: Lăsați-l la recepție și vi-l schimb imediat.
meaning: The receptionist asks the guest to leave the key card at reception so he can replace it right away.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Do you have something for a child's fever?

text: Max how many tims a day? And can i giv it with milk
meaning: The parent asks the maximum number of daily doses of the syrup and whether it can be given with milk.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I need something for my allergy.

text: O pastila pe zi, dimineata, nu mai mult de 7 zile fara medic
meaning: The pharmacist says to take one loratadine tablet each morning, for no more than 7 days without seeing a doctor.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Excuse me, where is the Palace of the Parliament?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Mergeți drept înainte, apoi la stânga.

text: Cool, gonna grab a coffee first, any spot nearby thats legit?
meaning: The tourist plans to get coffee first and asks for a good coffee place nearby.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Where can I buy a metro ticket?

history.speaker: A
history.text: The machine doesn't take my card.

text: Atunci mergeți la el, e lângă scara rulantă.
meaning: The local tells the traveler to go to the ticket counter, which is next to the escalator.

text: Love it, the food is amazing, especially the cabbage rills
meaning: The visitor loves Cluj and says the food is amazing, especially the cabbage rolls (sarmale).

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is it always this hot in August?

text: Mergem la mare la sfârșit de săptămână, e mișto, dar e nebunie de lume
meaning: The local says people go to the seaside on weekends, and it is nice but extremely crowded.

history.speaker: B

meaning: The local says to turn right at the traffic light and the ATM is next to the flower shop.

text: 你中文太牛了吧，yyds
meaning: The speaker praises the other person's Chinese as amazing, the best ever.

text: 老板，这双鞋有四十三马吗
meaning: The shopper asks if the shoes come in size 43.

history.speaker: B
history.text: 我还没订酒店，你有推荐吗？

history.speaker: A
history.text: There's Lotus Inn near the lake, or Harbor View by the station.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Harbor View is only five minutes from here.

text: 就去你刚才说的那家吧，近一点的
meaning: The passenger asks to go to Harbor View, the closer hotel just mentioned.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Our hotpot comes in mild, medium, or extra spicy.

text: 一点都不行，微啦也不行，给我清汤
meaning: The diner says they can't have any spice, not even mild, and want the plain broth.

history.speaker: B
history.text: 好甜㗎，菲律賓芒，一個十二蚊。

history.speaker: B
history.text: 木瓜大個廿五蚊，細個十八蚊。

text: ok ill take 2 of teh small papayas pls
meaning: The buyer wants two of the small papayas, which cost HK$18 each.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Ocean Terminal, Tsim Sha Tsui please.

history.speaker: B
history.text: 行紅隧定西隧？西隧貴啲但係快好多。

history.speaker: A
history.text: How much more is the western one?

text: fine take that one, I'm late
meaning: The passenger tells the driver to take the Western Harbour Tunnel despite the extra HK$40 because they are late.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Does the fried rice have any nuts?

history.speaker: B
history.text: 揚州炒飯冇果仁，不過有蝦。

history.speaker: B
history.text: 沙爹牛河就有花生醬㗎。

text: I'm deadly allergic to peanuts so skip the sated beef
meaning: The diner has a severe peanut allergy and will not order the satay beef noodles.

history.speaker: B
history.text: 你間房係1408，早餐七點到十點半。

history.speaker: B
history.text: 健身室喺五樓，廿四小時開放。

text: yo the AC in my room is busted, can u send someone asap
meaning: The guest in room 1408 reports a broken air conditioner and asks for someone to come immediately.

history.speaker: B
history.text: 呢隻止咳水，大人每次十毫升，一日三次。

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can my son take it? He's six.

history.speaker: B
history.text: 小朋友份量減半，每次五毫升。

text: so 5ml twice a dya for him or three tims?
meaning: The parent asks whether the six-year-old son takes 5 ml twice a day or three times a day.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Where's the MTR station for Central?

history.speaker: B
history.text: 直行，第一個路口見到恒生銀行轉左。

text: do I go in right by it or across the road from it?
meaning: The tourist asks whether the MTR entrance is right next to the 7-Eleven or across the road from it.

history.speaker: A
history.text: No, this is my fourth trip.

history.speaker: B
history.text: 咁你今次有冇去行山呀？

text: yeah Dragon's Back was lowkey insane, totally worth it
meaning: The speaker says the Dragon's Back hike was really amazing and well worth doing.

history.speaker: B
history.text: 生蝦一斤九十蚊，好新鮮。

text: Half a cat of prawns please, not the grouper
meaning: The buyer wants half a catty of prawns (about HK$45) and not the grouper.

history.speaker: B
history.text: 前面塞車，我兜去彌敦道好唔好？

text: ok but stop at the hsbc befor the hotel, need cash
meaning: The passenger agrees to the detour but wants to stop at an HSBC to get cash before reaching the hotel.

history.speaker: B
history.text: 呢個湯底有魚露同蝦醬。

text: great, do that for hers but mine can stay
meaning: The diner wants the wife's bowl switched to chicken broth while his own keeps the original broth.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How much is this jade bracelet?

text: 唔得啦，咁樣我蝕到入肉，最平七百五。
meaning: The vendor refuses HK$650 because she would lose a lot of money, and says HK$750 is the lowest price.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to the airport?

history.speaker: A
history.text: Yes, one big suitcase and a stroller.

text: 嗰個要摺埋先放得落，你識唔識摺？
meaning: The driver says the stroller has to be folded to fit in the trunk and asks if the passenger knows how to fold it.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is there egg in this cake?

history.speaker: A
history.text: My daughter is allergic to egg.

text: 咁你試吓呢件椰汁糕，冇蛋冇奶，系素嘅。
meaning: The baker suggests the coconut pudding for the daughter because it has no egg or milk and is vegan.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Welcome back, how was your day?

history.speaker: B
history.text: 幾好。聽朝可唔可以遲啲退房？

text: 唔該，麻煩送多四條毛巾上房，仲有個瘋筒壞咗。
meaning: The guest asks for four more towels sent to the room and reports that the hair dryer is broken.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Take one tablet every eight hours after meals.

text: 咁我夜晚瞓咗，使唔使扎醒食？
meaning: The patient asks whether they need to wake up at night to take a tablet.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Excuse me, which way to the Peak Tram?

history.speaker: B
history.text: 行去花園道，大約十分鐘。

text: 有少少斜，見到聖約翰坐堂就差唔多到。
meaning: The local says the walk is slightly uphill, and the tram is close once you see St John's Cathedral.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is that your dog in the photo?

history.speaker: B
history.text: 係呀，佢叫豆豆，我阿妹養嘅。

history.speaker: A
history.text: So cute! Does it live with you?

text: 唔係，佢搬咗去英國，所以佢而家同我阿媽住。
meaning: The speaker's sister moved to the UK, so the dog Doudou now lives with the speaker's mother.

text: 細盒廿二蚊，你要嘅話我幫你簡過啲靚嘅。
meaning: The vendor says a small box costs HK$22 and offers to pick out the best lychees.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you hurry? My ferry leaves at 9:40.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Central Pier, the boat to Mui Wo.

text: 放心，包你趕得切，呢個鐘數條路好鬆。
meaning: The driver assures the passenger they will make the 9:40 ferry because the roads are clear at this hour.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Your friend Mr. Lam left a package at reception.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Yes, and there's also a letter addressed to Ms. Chan.

text: 封信唔係我嘅，係佢老婆嘅，麻煩你留低畀佢。
meaning: The guest says the letter belongs to Mr. Lam's wife, Ms. Chan, and asks reception to hold it for her.

text: ill tak two bags of oinons and one pile of tomatos
meaning: The buyer wants two bags of onions and one pile of tomatoes.

text: Eish bhuti, ama-R95 yi-last price, angeke yehle.
meaning: The seller refuses R80 and says R95 is the final price.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Yes, my sister and her friend.

text: She pays for both of them, I already paid mine
meaning: The speaker's sister will pay the fares for herself and her friend, because the speaker has already paid.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Does this taxi go to Pinetown?

text: R18 bhuti. Uma sesifika, memeza 'after robot' ngizokwehlisa.
meaning: The fare is R18, and the passenger should call out 'after robot' to be dropped off just past the traffic light.

text: Is there any pianos in the sauce? Im allergic
meaning: The customer asks whether the curry sauce contains peanuts, because they are allergic.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can I get the beef stew?

history.speaker: A
history.text: My son can't eat milk products.

text: Akukho ubisi esitshulwini kodwa ilayisi liphekwe ngebhotol.
meaning: The stew has no milk, but the rice is cooked with butter.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I booked a room under Naidoo.

text: Can i get late chek out on the secnd day, like 1pm?
meaning: The guest asks for a late checkout at 1 pm on the second day.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The AC in my room is broken.

text: Yona sizoyishintsha manje, kodwa yena uzofika ngo-3 ntambama.
meaning: The hotel will replace the kettle now, and the mechanic will arrive at 3 pm.

text: Can my 6 yr old have the same serum? Maybe 5 ml?
meaning: The customer asks whether their 6-year-old can take the same cough syrup at a 5 ml dose.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I need something for a headache.

text: Ezimbili njalo emahoeni ayisithupha, ungedluli eziyisishiyagalombili ngosuku.
meaning: Take two pills every six hours, and no more than eight in a day.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Where are the Spar and the post office?

text: Ok which way to the far one, left or right?
meaning: The speaker asks whether to go left or right to reach the Spar.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do I get to Gateway mall?

text: Eish kude lokho mfethu, thatha i-taxi e-rank, yi-R14 nje.
meaning: The mall is too far to walk, so the speaker suggests taking a taxi from the rank, which costs only R14.

text: Honestly its lit, the beach vibes are unreal ngl
meaning: The speaker loves Durban and thinks the beach atmosphere is amazing.

text: AmaKhosi sho! Kodwa le sizini siyadumaza mfethu.
meaning: The speaker supports Kaizer Chiefs but says the team is disappointing this season.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The red beaded one and the blue one, how much?

text: I'll take the cheaper one, can you wrap it?
meaning: The buyer will take the blue necklace for R45 and asks the seller to wrap it.

text: Isidlo sasekuseni siqala ngo-6:30 estate sesibili.
meaning: Breakfast starts at 6:30 on the second floor; 'esitezi' was autocorrected to 'estate'.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to the airport?

text: Pls stop at an ATm first, i ony have R200 cash
meaning: The passenger asks the driver to stop at an ATM first because they only have R200 in cash.

history.speaker: A
history.text: My wife is allergic to fish, my son to eggs.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is the fish cake safe? There's no egg in it?

text: Akunaqanda, ngakho akumlungele yena kodwa indodana yakho ingakudla.
meaning: The fish cake has no egg, so it is not safe for the wife but the son can eat it.

text: Like 4 days, its lowkey getting worse and i feel kinda meh
meaning: The customer has had a sore throat for about four days, it is getting worse, and they feel unwell.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is the Zulu craft shop near here?

text: Hamba nqgo, jika kwesokunxele emarobhothini esibili, iseduze nebhange.
meaning: Go straight, turn left at the second traffic light, and the shop is next to the bank.
